title: Setting texture to png loaded from asset server causes crash

labels.name: A-Assets
labels.description: Load files from disk to use for things like images, models, and sounds

body:
Please see minimal example here https://github.com/jmrgibson/tntw/blob/bug_example/src/main.rs#L91

Trying to set a texture to a handle loaded from the asset server causes a crash. Setting a normal color texture works fine.

or, if I'm doing something wrong, please let me know :)

On ubuntu 20.04, nightly-2020-09-20
